Shared-memory funk record and transaction ID types, hashes, equality, copy, and error codes.

# Purpose
Defines the base types and helper functions for the `funk` record store and transaction system. It declares the fixed-size `fd_funk_rec_key_t` and `fd_funk_txn_xid_t` identifier types, plus the packed `fd_funk_xid_key_pair_t` structure used to address records by transaction and key. The file also provides error codes, alignment and footprint constants, hash and equality helpers, copy and atomic load/store helpers, and root-transaction utilities. It serves as the common header for code that works with funk records, transaction identifiers, and shared-memory funk objects.
